column3: Medium side shot: the boatman standing at the stern of a small wooden boat, rowing with the long oar through a snowstorm on a dark river, snowflakes as light-gray streaks, cresting waves at the bottom. Panel 1: oar forward, leaning in. Panel 2: pulling the oar back hard. Panel 3: oar out of the water, snow whipping his cape. Panel 4: braced against a big wave, hat tilted, determined.

Very wide shot: a tiny single boat with the boatman on a vast misty river between dark mountain silhouettes, a thin line of distant shore. Panel 1: boat small at left third, light snow. Panel 2: boat slightly further right, mist thinning. Panel 3: boat at center, a few tiny warm lantern dots appear on the water far behind. Panel 4: boat right of center, a long trail of many tiny lantern dots following behind on the water.

Close-up of the boatman's two cupped weathered hands (straw cape edges visible) in the dark, holding a small flame. Panel 1: a tiny dim spark. Panel 2: the spark grows. Panel 3: a small bright flame between the fingers lights the cape. Panel 4: a bright glowing flame lights his calm face under the hat above the hands.
